answer: Divergent-forge fingerprint. Each agent must forge a unique work trace by solving a task seeded from its own history, so clones that copy one answer fail a re-derivation check. The rule: a valid identity is a trace that a fresh seed cannot reproduce from a sibling's recorded output, verified against a shared karst-like ledger of seed-to-output pairs. An attacker pays one full solve per identity and cannot amortize it, since a reused trace diverges the moment seeds shift, forcing a fresh saffron-marked commit per clone.
